# KXDuracil

> > Premium manufacturer and supplier of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates, nutritional supplements, and specialty chemicals with GMP and FDA compliance.

KXDuracil (Shijiazhuang Kunxiangda Technology Co., Ltd.) is a China-based pharmaceutical manufacturer specializing in high-quality APIs, intermediates, and finished dosage forms for global markets. The company serves pharmaceutical, nutritional, water treatment, and industrial sectors with rigorous quality control and regulatory compliance standards.
